description: This file is a build configuration script for a Linux/OpenWrt-based project, defining device profiles, build procedures, and including other configuration snippets. It is not a traditional source code file but rather a build instruction file (.mk) used to generate firmware images for various devices.

methods.name: Build/addpattern
methods.description: Defines a build step to add pattern to the firmware image.

methods.name: Build/append-md5sum-bin
methods.description: Defines a build step to append MD5 checksum to a binary.

methods.name: Build/cybertan-trx
methods.description: Build step to create a binary image with TRX format.

methods.name: Build/dlink-sge-signature
methods.description: Signs firmware images with CRC and MD5 hashes for D-Link devices.

methods.name: Build/edimax-headers
methods.description: Generates firmware headers for Edimax devices.

methods.name: Build/mkdapimg2
methods.description: Creates a custom firmware image for D-Link DAP devices.

methods.name: Build/mkmylofw_16m
methods.description: Build step for creating specific device images with size padding.

methods.name: Build/mkwrggimg
methods.description: Creates raw firmware images for writing to specific devices.

methods.name: Build/nec-fw
methods.description: Build step for NEC firmware image formatting.

methods.name: Build/pisen_wmb001n-factory
methods.description: Creates factory firmware images for Pisen devices.

methods.name: Build/teltonika-fw-fake-checksum
methods.description: Adds a fake checksum for Teltonika firmware images.

methods.name: Build/wrgg-pad-rootfs
methods.description: Pads root filesystem in the firmware image.

methods.name: Build/zyxel-tar-bz2
methods.description: Creates nested tar.bz2 archive for Zyxel firmware.
